answer: Each new agent must solve a memory-hard puzzle that pins 4 GB of RAM for three sequential hours, seeded by a public beacon so no work can be precomputed. A fifth fake therefore keeps five 4 GB working sets resident at once, and each seed is anchored to a fresh beacon round, so a karst-style shared cache cannot serve them. Verifiers issue random ledge checkpoints mid-run, and any identity that misses one loses its slot.
